quartile_definition_variable: k (n_cohort: cohort node count per base test job)
boundary_convention: np.digitize(k, [q25_cut, q50_cut, q75_cut], right=False) + 1, clipped to [1,4]. Q1: k < q25_cut; Q2: q25_cut <= k < q50_cut; Q3: q50_cut <= k < q75_cut; Q4: k >= q75_cut. Left-closed, right-open for Q1–Q3; Q4 is left-closed only.
instrumentation_only_note: q_admit, q_drop, and all strat_* dicts are written AFTER placement decisions are committed (Stages 1–3 complete). They are never read by candidate construction, policy selection, look_ahead_safe, utilization state, thermal/exposure accounting, cabinet accounting, or classify_crossing. Quartile stratification is descriptive diagnostics only. No quartile-specific C_lower/C_upper crossings are defined (GATE_F_DESIGN §9).
